dispositions.inline: Execution of an inline Python program; the member identifies inputs, outputs and enclosing condition. Body and shell continuation belong to the same invocation.
dispositions.script: Execution of the named tracked Python file; argument expression and output/error effects are given by the member. Imports and children are separate edges.
dispositions.selection: Shell/PowerShell selects or tests an interpreter; no Python interpreter is executed by this line. The member identifies its actual consumers.
